parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of items to return per page when paginating results. The maximum is 100, and the default is 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query, which should be the value of the NextToken parameter from the previous API call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-instance-upgrade-history --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAc3HCuYhJi/wvpk4xOr0VLbAx7BkQzyYC+ONO+WudHGKEdB0uWSY7AGnM3qCgm/Ynge7zU6NWdbj0Tegyajyqyc= --service-instance-id si-0e6fca6a51a544200000 --region cn-hangzhou
